Description: The referee blows for the end of today's match.
The corner by Chris Brunt (West Brom) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
The free kick is delivered by Chris Brunt (West Brom) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.
Chris Brunt (West Brom) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
Luke Shaw (Southampton) was too forceful with his tackle and Howard Webb interrupted the game to signal a free kick. West Brom have a free kick.
Here comes a substitution. Tired Jay Rodriguez (Southampton) left the pitch, and Guly Do Prado (Southampton) is coming on to help his team.

Shane Long (West Brom) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
Matej Vydra (West Brom) and Liam Ridgewell combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
James Morrison (West Brom) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
Matej Vydra (West Brom) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
Here's the change. Morgan Amalfitano leaves the pitch and Matej Vydra (West Brom) comes on as a substitute.
Liam Ridgewell (West Brom) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
Substitution. James Ward-Prowse (Southampton) on for Adam Lallana.
The resulting corner from Morgan Amalfitano (West Brom) is cleared.

Chris Brunt (West Brom) produces a quality pass into the box, the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The assistant referee points towards the corner flag and it's going to be a corner kick.

A precise low pass is received by Gaston Ramirez (Southampton), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball crosses the byline and it's going to be a goal kick.
Southampton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
Chris Brunt (West Brom) dinks a cross into the box as he attempts to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to make a clearance.
The linesman signals that Jay Rodriguez (Southampton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
Today's match ends for Gareth McAuley who will be replaced by Zoltan Gera (West Brom).
Steven Reid (West Brom) attempts to find a head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box. The defence manages to outjump the attacking players and to avert the threat.
Nicolas Anelka goes off the pitch and Saido Berahino (West Brom) comes on.
Steven Davis (Southampton) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
Gaston Ramirez (Southampton) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
Jonas Olsson (West Brom) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

Adam Lallana (Southampton) and Gaston Ramirez (Southampton) show their ability as they combine brilliantly to find their teammates and are permanent threat for their opponents. Rickie Lambert (Southampton) received a sweet pass from Gaston Ramirez (Southampton), but the advance is stopped.
Long pass, produced by Jonas Olsson (West Brom), missed precision to reach his teammates.
Gaston Ramirez (Southampton) produces a good strike, that sails towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.

1 - 0
Adam Lallana (Southampton) meets a perfect cross from Gaston Ramirez on the edge of the penalty area and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike low behind the goalkeeper. It's 0:0.

Nicolas Anelka (West Brom) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Howard Webb stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Southampton are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
Nathaniel Clyne (Southampton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area. The opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
Southampton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
That's the end of the game for Jack Cork, who is replaced by Gaston Ramirez (Southampton).
Chris Brunt (West Brom) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
Shane Long (West Brom) picks up a yellow card.
Southampton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
Nicolas Anelka (West Brom) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
Jack Cork (Southampton) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
Nicolas Anelka (West Brom) brings an opponent down and Howard Webb interrupts the game. Southampton win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

Morgan Schneiderlin (Southampton) and Steven Davis combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues. Steven Davis (Southampton) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
Jay Rodriguez (Southampton) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker.
Luke Shaw (Southampton) sends a cross in and finds Jay Rodriguez (Southampton) inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.

Southampton slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
Howard Webb blows his whistle and the second half starts.
Howard Webb has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
Jay Rodriguez (Southampton) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! It's a goal kick.
Nicolas Anelka (West Brom) commits a foul and Howard Webb immediately signals a free kick.

Dejan Lovren (Southampton) sends an accurate pass to Jay Rodriguez (Southampton), who controls the ball with his fine first touch. Jay Rodriguez (Southampton) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
Rickie Lambert (Southampton) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
Steven Davis (Southampton) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

Steven Davis (Southampton) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area. The opposition's defence is alert, and one of the defenders clears the ball away. Steven Davis (Southampton) prepares to take a corner kick.
Flag goes up against Shane Long (West Brom) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
Steven Davis (Southampton) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.

The referee blows his whistle as Steven Reid (West Brom) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick has been awarded to Southampton. Steven Davis (Southampton) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
Rickie Lambert (Southampton) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.

A player from West Brom brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Southampton. Rickie Lambert (Southampton) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
Adam Lallana (Southampton) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
Rickie Lambert (Southampton) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Ben Foster.
Wonderful movement by Southampton. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
Shane Long (West Brom) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
Luke Shaw (Southampton) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates. The opposing defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
Howard Webb blows his whistle for a foul after Morgan Schneiderlin (Southampton) hacks down one of his opponents.

Chris Brunt (West Brom) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
Rickie Lambert (Southampton) commits a rough foul. Howard Webb stops the game and makes a call. West Brom will take a free kick near the side line.
The resulting free kick from Chris Brunt (West Brom) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
Chris Brunt (West Brom) will take the free kick.
Steven Reid (West Brom) wins the ball from the resulting free kick and unleashes a shot which sails just over the crossbar!
Dejan Lovren (Southampton) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
Steven Reid (West Brom) takes a direct free kick.
Morgan Schneiderlin (Southampton) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Howard Webb signals. West Brom earn a free kick.
Nathaniel Clyne (Southampton) delivers a promising cross into the box, but one of the defending players wins the ball and averts the threat.
Southampton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
The resulting corner from Steven Davis (Southampton) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
Steven Davis (Southampton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
Luke Shaw (Southampton) produces a cross into the box. The opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Corner kick. It will be taken by Adam Lallana (Southampton).
Jay Rodriguez (Southampton) attempts to set up his teammate into a scoring opportunity with a fine chip pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.

Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Southampton are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

What a poor attempt! Steven Davis (Southampton) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands. It is going to be a goal kick.
Chris Brunt (West Brom) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
Wasted opportunity. Rickie Lambert (Southampton) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. That will be a goal kick.

Ben Foster makes a brilliant save! Adam Lallana (Southampton) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
Southampton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
Nicolas Anelka (West Brom) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Southampton in a dangerous position.
Jay Rodriguez (Southampton) superbly chipped the ball over the defenders to feed Adam Lallana (Southampton) in run. One of the defenders managed to clear the ball.
Chris Brunt (West Brom) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

Howard Webb checks if everything is ready for the beginning of the match and we get underway.
